title: From a file every minute to one clear decision
summary: A results file from every system is checked, stored, compared to normal and explained by AI in a morning report and fast alerts.

steps.title: A file arrives
steps.caption: Every system sends a results file every minute: revenue, profit and orders, for every store and product.
steps.engineering: File lands in object storage; an event triggers processing; the file name holds the source and minute.
steps.presenterNote: It starts with something boring on purpose: a plain results file, every minute, from every system. Boring inputs are easy to trust.

steps.title: We check it
steps.caption: Wrong or missing numbers are stopped before anyone sees them, and set aside with the reason.
steps.engineering: Schema and range validation; bad files are quarantined with a reason; late or duplicate files are handled by source + minute key.
steps.presenterNote: Nothing reaches a person until it passes the checks. A bad file is set aside with a reason, so nobody decides anything on broken numbers.

steps.title: We store it
steps.caption: Kept in a form built for fast totals, by minute, store and product.
steps.engineering: Columnar analytics store, partitioned by minute; roll-ups to hour and day.
steps.presenterNote: We keep it in a shape made for totals, so a question like revenue by store since two o'clock comes back in seconds.

steps.title: We compare to normal
steps.caption: Is this Monday unusual for this store, at this time? We compare every number to what is normal.
steps.engineering: Seasonal baseline per metric × store × hour-of-week, plus deviation bands; simple, explainable rules first.
steps.presenterNote: The question is never whether revenue is down. It's whether it's down compared to a normal Monday at two o'clock, for this store.

steps.title: We explain it
steps.caption: One short report every morning, and an alert within 2 minutes when something breaks.
steps.engineering: Numbers computed in SQL; the AI writes only the sentence; a checker verifies every number in the text against the source before sending.
steps.presenterNote: Only at the end does AI appear, and it only writes the sentence. The numbers come from the data, and a checker reads the text before anyone else does.
